title: Guided Diffusion by Optimized Loss Functions on Relaxed Parameters for Inverse Material Design
abstract: arXiv:2602.15648v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inverse design problems are common in engineering and materials science. The forward direction, i.e., computing output quantities from design parameters, typically requires running a numerical simulation, such as a FEM, as an intermediate step, which is an optimization problem by itself. In many scenarios, several design parameters can lead to the same or similar output values. For such cases, multi-modal probabilistic approaches are advantageous to obtain diverse solutions. A major difficulty in inverse design stems from the structure of the design space, since discrete parameters or further constraints disallow the direct use of gradient-based optimization. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel inverse design method based on diffusion models. translated_title: 基于松弛参数优化损失函数引导扩散模型的逆向材料设计
translated_abstract: 逆向设计问题在工程和材料科学中很常见。正向方向，即从设计参数计算输出量，通常需要运行数值模拟（如有限元方法）作为中间步骤，这本身就是一个优化问题。在许多场景中，多个设计参数可能导致相同或相似的输出值。对于这种情况，多模态概率方法有利于获得多样化的解决方案。逆向设计的一个主要困难源于设计空间的结构，因为离散参数或进一步约束不允许直接使用基于梯度的优化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于扩散模型的新型逆向设计方法。我们的方法将原始设计空间松弛为连续网格表示，其中梯度可以通过正向模拟中的隐式微分计算。一个扩散模型被训练以生成满足目标输出条件的松弛参数，并通过优化损失函数来引导生成过程，从而在保持多样性的同时实现精确的逆向设计。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的新型逆向材料设计方法，通过将离散设计空间松弛为连续网格表示并利用隐式微分计算梯度，结合优化损失函数引导生成，有效解决了多模态逆向设计中的梯度不可用难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel diffusion-model-based inverse material design method that relaxes discrete design spaces into continuous grid representations, enabling gradient computation via implicit differentiation and guided generation through optimized loss functions to address multimodal inverse design challenges.
